paragraphs: The E-Pace P200 has been part of the E-Pace range since the model launched in 2017. The P200 uses the AJ200 - a 2.0-litre four-cylinder petrol engine from Jaguar Land Rover's Ingenium family. It sits as the entry-level petrol option in the E-Pace line-up, positioned below the discontinued P250 and alongside the D165 and D200 diesel variants and the P300e plug-in hybrid.

cards.body: A 2.0L I4 Petrol engine fitted to the E-Pace P200 - X540 (2017-present).
